_note: Domain events and their subscriber scripts. Lifecycle wiring lives in .claude/settings.json; this file documents intent. Scripts read their payload via _hooklib.load_payload(), so both Claude Code (stdin) and tools/run_hook.py (HOOK_PAYLOAD) work.

session-start.description: At session start; validates .claude/ structure and scaffolds knowledge docs

pre-run.description: Before work starts on a turn; logs, routes skills, checks doc staleness

post-run.description: After a turn completes; audit, notify, checkpoint, doc-staleness check

pre-commit.description: Before a git commit/push finalizes; secrets, branch, review receipt, delivery gate

pre-edit.description: Before a file write; refuses generated, vendored and lockfile targets

pre-deploy.description: Before a cloud-CLI command; allowlist-first free-tier spend guard

on-artifact-create.description: When a new artifact is written; registers it, nudges hook self-tests

on-error.description: When a tool call fails (user interrupts excluded)

on-validate-fail.description: When a validator fails; self-filters failed tool calls down to validator commands

on-deploy-failure.description: When an automated deploy fails (rollback candidate)

on-human-approval-request.description: When a permission prompt is raised

on-blueprint-promote.description: When a blueprint is promoted to canonical. No lifecycle event corresponds to this -- invoke via tools/run_hook.py
on-blueprint-promote._note: No claude_code_event: this is a domain event with no Claude Code lifecycle trigger. Fired manually via tools/run_hook.py. Absence from settings.json is deliberate, not drift.

post-tool.description: After any tool result arrives; meters how many characters it added to the context window
